details.title: Altered scales
details.lead: Every tension a dominant 7th can take: ♭9, ♯9, ♯11 and ♭13. The 7th mode of melodic minor. Each key goes up and down two octaves from its lowest tonic, then over the whole horn: up to the highest note of the scale at or below double high B♭, down to the lowest, and back to the tonic.
facts: All 12, from B♭ up by half steps
